newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - Oct 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Separate courts to deal with cases of repression on women and children will start functioning at all district head quarters from November.
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has asserted that trial of the killers of independence leader Sheikh Mujibur Rahman and his family members will be held.
Bangladesh is considering a law against narcotics trade, proposing stringent measures against drug traffickers including their extradition, government officials said.
Delta Life Insurance Co has introduced an individual medical insurance scheme, first of its kind in Bangladesh.
Asian Development Bank (ADB) will provide Bangladesh $90 million in soft term loan for a project aimed at improving urban poverty.
